summary: Yuanbao Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results, with no transaction, corporate action, or special situation involved. Q2 2026 total revenues were RMB1,392.2 million (US$205.2 million), up 30.1% year-over-year, while net income rose 35.6% to RMB413.2 million (US$60.9 million), a 29.7% net margin. Net operating cash inflow was RMB419.1 million. The release also highlighted multimodal AI deployments in insurance claims assistance, reaching 95% document classification accuracy. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or shareholder vote were disclosed; this is a routine earnings filing.
